events.title: 웨스트햄 유나이티드 are the only First Division side with a 100% record after three games after beating London rivals 토트넘 홋스퍼 2–0 at White Hart Lane .

웨스트햄 유나이티드 extend their 100% start to the season to four games and remain top with a 3–1 home win over 레스터 시티. 맨체스터 유나이티드 beat 아스널 3–2 at Highbury . 입스위치 타운 are second in the table with three wins from their opening four games after a 3–0 home win over 에버턴 .

웨스트햄 유나이티드 make it five wins in a row with a 5–2 home win over 코번트리 시티 , with David Swindlehurst scoring a hat-trick. 입스위치 타운 keep up their challenge with a 5–0 home win over 스토크 시티 , as do third-placed 맨체스터 유나이티드 with a 2–0 home win over 루턴 타운. 레스터 시티 are still looking for their first point of the season after a 3–0 home defeat at home to 토트넘 홋스퍼.

Dutch club Groningen makes its European debut with a defeat (2–1) against Spain's 아틀레티코 마드리드 in the first round of the UEFA Cup . On the same night, NEC makes its European club football debut with a 1–1 draw with Brann in the first round (first leg) of the Cup Winners' Cup .

웨스트햄 유나이티드's perfect start to the season ends with a 1–0 defeat at 웨스트브로미치 앨비언 , although they are still top of the First Division. 사우샘프턴 go second with a 3–0 home win over 맨체스터 유나이티드. 맨체스터 시티 's bid for an immediate return to the First Division is boosted by a 6–0 home win over 블랙번 로버스 , lifting them to second place in the Second Division. 스완지 시티 are facing a battle avoid a second successive relegation after collecting one point from their first five games.
England lose 1–0 to Denmark in their European Championship qualifier at Wembley , making qualification for the Finals unlikely.
뉴캐슬 유나이티드 boost their Second Division promotion push by signing Peter Beardsley , who was rejected by 맨체스터 유나이티드 last previous season, in a £150,000 deal from Vancouver Whitecaps .

웨스트햄 유나이티드 return to their winning ways and maintain their lead of the First Division by beating 노츠 카운티 3–0 at Upton Park . 맨체스터 유나이티드 keep up the pressure by beating 리버풀 1–0 at Old Trafford . 사우샘프턴's title challenge is hit with a 1–0 defeat away to 애스턴 빌라, who go sixth in the table. 울버햄프턴 원더러스, with no wins from their first seven games, lose 4–0 at home to QPR . 레스터 시티 finally pick up a league point at the seventh attempt with a 2–2 draw at home to 스토크 시티.
맨체스터 유나이티드 progress to the second round of the European Cup Winners' Cup by eliminating Czech side Dukla Prague on away goals.

All four English entrants in the UEFA Cup – 왓퍼드 , 노팅엄 포리스트 , 토트넘 홋스퍼 and 애스턴 빌라 – progress to the second round. 토트넘 홋스퍼 recorded a 14–0 aggregate victory over Irish side Drogheda United , while 왓퍼드 came from 3–1 down against West German side Kaiserlautern in the first leg to win the second leg 3–0 at Vicarage Road .

With six wins from seven matches, 웨스트햄 유나이티드 are top of the First Division at the end of September, with 맨체스터 유나이티드, 사우샘프턴 , 리버풀 and 입스위치 타운 completing the top five. 레스터 시티's terrible start to the season sees them prop up the top flight with only a single point from their opening seven games. 울버햄프턴 원더러스 (winless) and 스토크 시티 (one win) complete the bottom three. 셰필드 웬즈데이 head the race for promotion from the Second Division, followed closely behind by recently relegated 맨체스터 시티 and a 허더즈필드 타운 side who only won promotion from the Fourth Division four seasons ago. 미들즈브러 , 찰턴 애슬레틱 and 첼시 have also made a good start to the Second Division campaign.
